hypothesis: Explicit CBR guidance about possible future rate hikes/cuts predicts delayed equity/FX adjustment after publication. Hawkish guidance shorts both MIX (discount-rate pressure) and SI (RUB support); dovish guidance buys both. This is an unproved economic inference, not a guarantee of either response.
relationship: New qualitative next-action communication, not the numerical key-rate level/governor V27, survey revisions V21 or fiscal-liquidity V71. No retuned old price rule or new trading engine.

source.availability: 23:59:59 Moscow on printed publication date, current-vintage development assumption only; original historical text versions and within-day receipts are not proved
source.rights: Personal research from public CBR Press Service releases; source attribution retained; no raw redistribution in Git

signal.primary: Negative of explicit next-rate-action sign: hike +1, cut -1; both or neither direction gives flat. Same fixed direction for MIX and SI.
signal.control: Negative of actual headline action (hike/cut/hold), without forward text direction. Same source identity/timing masks; diagnostic only, never promotable by selecting a good control outcome.
signal.dictionary: Exact sealed classify() constants FUTURE/NEGATIVE/ACTUAL/HIKE/CUT. Sentence-level future marker AND hike/cut directly governing key-rate phrase, optionally via 'level'/'magnitude'; no arbitrary intervening words. Lowercase, yo-to-e, split on punctuation followed by whitespace. Actual-decision and explicit-negation sentences excluded; 'does not exclude' is possibility, not a negation.
signal.missing: Unknown/multiple headline actions or empty body mask both arms. No explicit guidance is a valid flat state, not a claim of neutral CBR policy. Latest neutral, contradictory or unknown release supersedes any older directional one.
signal.schedule: Daily EOD decision, source publication_date <= decision_date AND available_at <= decision_at; next factual active-contract open strictly later than decision_date. Weekend releases cannot be backdated into Friday plans.
signal.fit: none; text facts only, no market data enters extraction

execution.terminal: flat at last factual effective date before 2026; halts and carried positions remain visible
execution.input_scope: Build exact matching full observations/spec market first, then filter BOTH assets and dates. No subset-observation/full-spec join mismatch. Causal active map and strictly-prior sizing specs inherited from pinned V64 recent catalog.

screen_gates.coverage_denominator: all 68 provider releases; readable headline/body state fraction, NOT directional signal fraction
screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE component only, not verified 20-50 percent annual return

validation.scheme: already-open 2018-2025 development history; no fit, future labels, hyperparameter search or selected folds; all eight annual returns reported

limitations: Current-vintage press-release text may include later revisions. Published labels and conservative EOD do not prove original historical receipt or original bytes.

Narrow lexical next-action rule is not a validated general sentiment model. It may miss indirect guidance, pronouns, higher-for-longer language, or complex negation/conditional clauses. No LLM or outcome-selected dictionary repair.
Expected policy can already be priced, and economic-information effects can oppose discount-rate or FX effects. Headline action is not a market-consensus surprise.
Primary and headline control naturally differ in exposure frequency; no outcome-driven exposure matching or control promotion.
Daily opens, fees, margin and sizing specs remain historical research proxies, not original executable BBO or confirmed broker tariffs. A 1x target is not a guaranteed 1x close-mark leverage cap.
Repeatedly opened development history does not establish predictable earnings. Stage1 cannot authorize demo activation or live orders.
forbidden_followups: tune dictionary, sign, holding age, universe, leverage, gates or costs after outcomes
